I saved Dana's note in gbrain (Dock 38 for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups from 2026-10-14) and confirmed in her DM. But I can't read it back yet, so I don't know if it will come up when she asks.

- **First save was too open:** gbrain marked it "world", meaning anyone using the brain could see it. That would break the rule against carrying DM content into other people's conversations, so I removed it (fact #1). I saved it again marked private (fact #2).
- **Reading notes back doesn't work:** gbrain refused my read request. The brain serves several people, and this connection isn't linked to any member, so it reads nothing. Only whoever runs the brain server can fix this, using gbrain's suggested command: `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`. A shared bot can be set up to act for several named members instead.
- **What I told Dana:** I replied in her DM thread. I said the note is saved as private, that I may not be able to pull it up until reading is fixed, and that she should remind me if I can't.
